# half-stache (Sam Hutcherson)

> Sam Hutcherson is a mechanical engineer and software developer. He builds iOS apps, websites for small businesses, and a hydrology model of the Little Red River in Arkansas, and he releases music under his own name. Client work runs through Hutchware LLC.

The site is at https://half-stache.github.io: a home page, one page per project under /work/, and a brand sheet at /brand/. The email address is halfstache@hotmail.com.

## Work

- [VectorShield](https://half-stache.github.io/work/vectorshield/): an iOS and Apple Watch app for people with alpha-gal syndrome, on the App Store. It scans products, checks medications against FDA data, and finds safe food, tuned to one of four sensitivity levels. A Chrome extension does the same on retail sites. Site: https://vectorshield.app. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vectorshield/id6759514220
- [Riverstock](https://half-stache.github.io/work/riverstock/): a hydrology model of the Little Red River below Greers Ferry Dam that predicts river conditions at each access point. The model and data pipeline are built; the API and apps are in progress.
- [LavaRise](https://half-stache.github.io/work/lavarise/): a pixel-art climbing game for iPhone with 100 levels and 10 chapters. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lavarise/id6759515609
- [Hutch's RV Park](https://half-stache.github.io/work/hutchs-rv-park/): website, brand, and content system for the family RV park in Searcy, Arkansas. Site: https://hutchsrv.com
- [Elrod Construction & Services](https://half-stache.github.io/work/elrod-construction/): website, logo, and hero video for a home builder in Texarkana. Site: https://elrodconstructionservices.com

## Background

He has a mechanical engineering degree and finished as valedictorian and summa cum laude. He won a Startup Junkie healthcare boot camp. He was an account manager at his family's insurance agency, where he built document filing automation that saves each account manager thirty to sixty minutes a day.
